pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Bubba G's pickin' DR Congo like they're holdin' secret talent camps in his backyard, but today ain't the day to be slippin' against Ghost Pepper's Spain. France has been puttin' in work, with Gunner ridin' high at the top of our pool thanks to their sparkling form. But man, Gunner's draft choices look like he blindfolded himself and threw darts at a map; pickin' DR Congo might've been his way of diversifyin' his craziness. Meanwhile, Devin's Spain play it cool, with their tactical smarts and star-studded lineup that could spell trouble for France. In Arlington, a place I know a little something about, my call is easy — Spain's gonna dance all over the field and Rafe's probably in the stands rootin' for the wrong team.

pundit_takes.headline: Mustard Boy Zach Blames Swiss For Losing To Argentina
pundit_takes.subtitle: 'I thought they had chocolate-level defending,' he reportedly said.

pundit_takes.subtitle: 'Losing is just part of the strategy,' sources overheard.

pundit_takes.subtitle: Believes advancement points will 'just happen, man'.

pundit_takes.headline: Gayden The Backpass Assassin Claims England's Victory Was By Design
pundit_takes.subtitle: Cites advanced points theory understood only by him.

rome_analytics_quotes: Rafe, zero win chance but dominating Devin. Kid's pure chaos with no soccer clue.
Rafe's draft picks: proof that knowing nothing can still earn you last place.
Devin, shut out by Rafe at 0-2. Your kryptonite is a teenager.
Gunner was the sim favorite until Rafe showed up. Can't plan for teenage disruption.
